التهاب مزمن متكرر في حواف الجفون يرتبط ب: Long-term, recurring inflammation of the eyelid margins linked to problems with the eyelid glands, dandruff or bacteria, causing itching, burning and crusts on the eyelashes.
كمادات دافئة يوميًا ثم تدليك حافة الجفن: Use warm compresses daily, then gently massage and clean the eyelid margins. Use artificial tears for dryness and treat dandruff if present. The condition is long-term: it can be controlled but not cured for good. See a doctor if it does not improve within a few weeks, or if you develop pain, reduced vision or severe redness.
كتلة صغيرة غير مؤلمة غالبًا في الجفن تنت: A small, usually painless lump in the eyelid caused by a blocked oil gland (meibomian gland). Unlike a stye, it is usually not inflamed.
كمادات دافئة وتدليك لطيف عدة مرات يوميًا: Apply warm compresses and gently massage several times a day for a few weeks; most clear up on their own within one to two months. See a doctor if it grows, presses on your vision, keeps coming back in the same spot or lasts more than two months, as it may need a simple drainage or tests to rule out other causes.
التهاب الغشاء المبطّن للعين والجفن نتيجة: Inflammation of the membrane lining the eye and eyelid caused by an allergy to pollen, dust or pet dander. Its main feature is severe itching in both eyes.
تجنّب المسبب ما أمكن، وكمادات باردة، وغس: Avoid the trigger where possible, use cold compresses, rinse the eyes with artificial tears and use anti-allergy eye drops. See a doctor if you develop real pain, reduced vision or severe sensitivity to light, or if symptoms do not improve despite treatment.
تمزّق وعاء دموي صغير تحت الغشاء الشفاف ل: A small blood vessel breaks under the clear membrane covering the white of the eye, leaving a bright red patch, often after coughing, sneezing or straining. It is painless and does not affect vision.
لا يحتاج علاجًا ويزول خلال أسبوعين تقريب: No treatment is needed; it clears in about two weeks, changing color like a bruise. Check your blood pressure if it keeps happening. See a doctor if it followed a hard injury, comes with pain or reduced vision, happens often, or if you take blood thinners (warfarin) or have bruises elsewhere.
جرح سطحي في الطبقة الخارجية الشفافة للعي: A surface scratch on the clear outer layer of the eye (cornea) from a fingernail, paper, contact lens or foreign body, causing sharp pain, watering and sensitivity to light.
يحتاج فحصًا بصبغة الفلوريسين في اليوم نف: It needs a same-day examination with fluorescein dye, plus a preventive antibiotic ointment or drops and a painkiller. It usually heals within one to three days. Do not wear contact lenses until it has healed. Go to the emergency department straight away if the injury was from a fast-moving or sharp object, if the pain is severe with clearly reduced vision, or if it has not improved within two days.
دخول ذرة غبار أو رمل أو برادة معدنية إلى: A speck of dust, sand or metal filing gets onto the surface of the eye or under the eyelid, causing a gritty feeling, watering and redness.
اغسل العين بماء نظيف أو محلول ملحي غزير،: Rinse the eye with plenty of clean water or saline. Do not try to remove an object stuck to the cornea with a tool. Metal filings leave a rust ring and need to be removed in a clinic. Go to the emergency department straight away if the object flew in at high speed (hammering metal, grinding or an explosion) as it may have penetrated the eye, if your vision is reduced, or if pain continues after rinsing.
التهاب في الطبقة الوسطى الملوّنة من العي: Inflammation of the colored middle layer of the eye (iris), causing deep pain, redness around the cornea, light sensitivity and blurred vision. It may be linked to immune conditions such as ankylosing spondylitis.
يحتاج فحص طبيب العيون خلال 24 ساعة؛ العل: It needs an eye doctor's examination within 24 hours. Treatment is with steroid eye drops and pupil-dilating drops to ease pain and prevent the iris from sticking, with tests for an immune cause if it keeps coming back. Delay can lead to raised eye pressure, cataract or loss of vision.
انقطاع مفاجئ للدم عن الشبكية بسبب جلطة أ: A sudden interruption of blood supply to the retina from a clot or embolus in its artery, causing sudden painless loss of vision in one eye. It is treated as the equivalent of a stroke.
حالة طارئة: اتصل بالإسعاف أو اذهب إلى أق: This is an emergency: call an ambulance or go to the nearest stroke center straight away, as possible treatment depends on the first few hours. Afterwards, a full stroke work-up is needed (carotid arteries, heart, blood pressure, blood sugar and cholesterol), and giant cell (temporal) arteritis should be ruled out in people over 50.
انسداد الوريد الذي يصرّف الدم من الشبكية: A blockage of the vein that drains blood from the retina, causing bleeding and swelling in the retina and painless blurred vision in one eye. The main causes are high blood pressure, diabetes and glaucoma.
يحتاج فحص طبيب العيون خلال يوم أو يومين،: It needs an eye doctor's examination within a day or two, along with control of blood pressure, blood sugar and cholesterol. Injections into the eye or laser may be needed to treat swelling of the macula or abnormal blood vessel growth. Seek care straight away if your vision gets worse quickly or you develop severe pain.
تسرّب دم إلى السائل الهلامي داخل العين،: Blood leaking into the gel inside the eye, often from abnormal blood vessels in people with diabetes or from a retinal tear, causing a sudden haze or dark spots.
يحتاج فحص طبيب العيون في اليوم نفسه للبح: It needs a same-day eye doctor's examination to look for a retinal tear or detachment; rest with your head raised. Treatment depends on the cause: retinal laser, injections into the eye, or surgery to remove the vitreous (vitrectomy) if the blood is not absorbed.
التهاب في العصب البصري يسبب ضعفًا في رؤي: Inflammation of the optic nerve that causes reduced vision in one eye over a few days, with pain when moving the eye and washed-out colors. It is often the first sign of multiple sclerosis in young adults.
يحتاج تقييمًا عاجلًا لدى طبيب العيون أو: It needs urgent assessment by an eye doctor or neurologist within 24 hours, with an MRI of the brain. Intravenous steroids may be given to speed recovery, and most people improve over weeks to months. Go to the emergency department if it comes with weakness in the limbs or difficulty speaking.
انفصال السائل الهلامي داخل العين عن الشب: The gel inside the eye separates from the retina with age, causing sudden floaters and flashes of light. It is usually not serious, but it can cause a retinal tear in a small number of people.
يحتاج فحص قاع العين الموسّع خلال 24 ساعة: You need a dilated eye examination within 24 hours of new flashes or floaters to rule out a retinal tear, which is treated with laser. If the examination is normal, no treatment is needed and the floaters gradually become less noticeable. Go to the emergency department straight away if a shadow or curtain blocks part of your vision or the floaters suddenly increase.
ظلال صغيرة لنقاط أو خيوط داخل السائل اله: Small shadows of dots or threads in the gel inside the eye that move as the eye moves. They are very common with short-sightedness and aging, and are harmless if long-standing and unchanged.
لا تحتاج علاجًا ويتأقلم معها الدماغ مع ا: No treatment is needed, and the brain gets used to them over time. A retinal examination at least once is recommended. See an eye doctor the same day if they suddenly increase in number, or come with flashes of light or a shadow blocking your vision.
ضعف في إبصار عين واحدة (وأحيانًا العينين: Reduced vision in one eye (and sometimes both) in a child because the brain has not learned to use it properly, due to a squint, a large difference in prescription between the eyes, or an obstruction such as a cataract.
العلاج فعّال كلما بدأ مبكرًا قبل سن 7 سن: Treatment works best when started early, before age 7: suitable glasses, then patching the stronger eye for some hours a day or using drops that temporarily blur its vision, with regular follow-up with a pediatric eye doctor. Have your child's eyes tested before starting school, even if they have no complaints.
انخفاض الجفن العلوي عن موضعه الطبيعي، وأ: The upper eyelid sits lower than its normal position. The most common cause is loosening of the lifting muscle's tendon with age or contact lens use; it may also be present from birth or caused by muscle or nerve weakness.
يحتاج تقييمًا لدى طبيب العيون لمعرفة الس: It needs assessment by an eye doctor to find the cause and measure its effect on your field of vision; treatment is usually surgery if it blocks vision. Go to the emergency department straight away if it appears suddenly with double vision, a widened pupil or a severe headache. See a doctor soon if it gets worse later in the day with muscle weakness (possible myasthenia gravis).
ضعف مفاجئ في العصب المسؤول عن رفع الجفن: Sudden weakness of the nerve that lifts the eyelid, moves the eye and narrows the pupil, causing a drooping eyelid and double vision. If the pupil is widened, it may indicate a life-threatening brain aneurysm.
اذهب إلى الطوارئ فورًا لتصوير الأوعية ال: Go to the emergency department straight away for urgent imaging of the brain's blood vessels to rule out an aneurysm or stroke. التهاب مناعي في أنسجة الحجاج وعضلات العي: Immune inflammation of the tissues of the eye socket and eye muscles, usually with an overactive thyroid (Graves' disease), causing bulging eyes, eyelid retraction, dryness and sometimes double vision.
يحتاج متابعة مشتركة بين طبيب الغدد وطبيب: It needs joint follow-up with a hormone (endocrine) specialist and an eye doctor, with control of thyroid function, stopping smoking (the most important factor that makes it worse), artificial tears for dryness, and a selenium supplement in mild cases. Go to the emergency department if your vision gets worse, colors look washed out, or you cannot close your eye.
إصابة سطح العين بمادة قلوية (كالجير والأ: Injury to the surface of the eye from an alkaline substance (such as lime, cement or oven cleaners) or an acid. Alkalis are more dangerous because they penetrate quickly and can cause blindness.
ابدأ فورًا بغسل العين بماء جارٍ نظيف أو: Start rinsing the eye immediately with clean running water or plenty of saline for at least 15 to 30 minutes, holding the eyelids open, before doing anything else. Then go to the emergency department while continuing to rinse, and take the product container with you. Do not try to neutralize the substance with another one.
مجموعة أعراض كجفاف العين وحرقانها وتشوّش: A group of symptoms such as dry, burning eyes, temporary blurred vision, headache and neck pain after long use of screens, caused by blinking less and the effort of focusing up close.
قاعدة 20-20-20: كل 20 دقيقة انظر إلى شيء: Follow the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something about 6 meters away for 20 seconds. Place the screen a little farther away and below eye level, lower the brightness, and use artificial tears. Correct any vision problem with suitable glasses. See an eye doctor if symptoms continue despite this or your vision gets worse.
ضعف تدريجي طبيعي في قدرة العين على الترك: A normal, gradual decline in the eye's ability to focus on close objects, usually starting after age 40 as the lens loses its flexibility.
تُصحّح بنظارة قراءة أو نظارة متعددة البؤ: It is corrected with reading glasses, multifocal glasses or suitable contact lenses after an eye test. A full eye examination after 40, including eye pressure to rule out glaucoma, is recommended. See a doctor if loss of vision is sudden or in one eye only.

يحتاج تقييمًا طبيًا في اليوم نفسه ومضادً: It needs a same-day medical assessment and oral antibiotics, with follow-up within one to two days. Young children may need intravenous treatment. Go to the emergency department straight away if there is pain on moving the eye, bulging of the eye, double vision or reduced vision, as these are signs of orbital cellulitis.

حالة طارئة: اذهب إلى الطوارئ فورًا. العل: This is an emergency: go to the emergency department straight away. Treatment is in hospital with intravenous antibiotics and an urgent CT scan, and surgical drainage of an abscess or the sinuses may be needed. Delay can cause blindness or meningitis.
التهاب خفيف في الطبقة الرقيقة فوق بياض ا: Mild inflammation of the thin layer over the white of the eye, causing localized redness and slight discomfort without discharge or effect on vision. It usually clears on its own.
يتحسن تلقائيًا خلال أسبوع إلى ثلاثة أساب: It improves on its own within one to three weeks; cold compresses and artificial tears help, and a doctor may prescribe an anti-inflammatory. التهاب عميق ومؤلم في الجدار الأبيض للعين: Deep, painful inflammation of the white wall of the eye, often linked to immune conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis. It causes severe pain spreading to the face and waking you from sleep, with dark redness.
يحتاج فحص طبيب العيون خلال 24 ساعة؛ العل: It needs an eye doctor's examination within 24 hours. Treatment is with oral anti-inflammatories, steroids or immunosuppressants, along with tests for an associated immune condition. Left untreated, it can thin the wall of the eye and reduce vision.
عدم انفتاح القناة التي تصرّف الدموع إلى: The duct that drains tears into the nose has not opened at birth, causing constant watering, discharge and crusting on the eyelashes. It clears on its own in most babies before age one.
تدليك لطيف للزاوية الداخلية للعين نحو ال: Gently massage the inner corner of the eye toward the nose several times a day, and clean away discharge with cotton wool and cooled boiled water. See a doctor if the skin becomes red or the inner corner swells (dacryocystitis), if the white of the eye turns red, or if it continues after age one.
عدوى في الكيس الدمعي عند الزاوية الداخلي: Infection of the tear sac at the inner corner of the eye due to a blocked tear duct, causing a painful red swelling, watering and discharge.
يحتاج تقييمًا طبيًا في اليوم نفسه ومضادً: It needs a same-day medical assessment and oral antibiotics, with warm compresses. Do not try to squeeze the sac forcefully. Once the infection settles, a surgical procedure to create a new tear drainage channel may be needed if it keeps coming back. Go to the emergency department if the swelling spreads to the whole eyelid, or if there is pain on moving the eye or reduced vision.
نسيج لحمي مثلث ينمو من الملتحمة نحو القر: A triangular fleshy tissue growing from the conjunctiva toward the cornea, usually on the side near the nose. It is linked to long-term exposure to sun and dust, and is sometimes preceded by a yellowish bump that does not extend onto the cornea (pinguecula).
النظارات الشمسية والدموع الصناعية تخفف ا: Sunglasses and artificial tears ease irritation and slow its growth. It needs follow-up with an eye doctor; surgery with a conjunctival graft is done when it approaches the center of the cornea or causes astigmatism. Seek care if your vision gets worse or severe redness keeps coming back.
إعادة نشاط فيروس الجديري في فرع العصب ال: Reactivation of the chickenpox virus in the branch of the nerve supplying the forehead and eye, causing a painful blistering rash on one side. It can affect the eye itself, causing inflammation of the cornea or iris.
يحتاج طبيبًا خلال 24 ساعة لبدء مضاد الفي: See a doctor within 24 hours to start antiviral medicine within 72 hours of the rash appearing, and have your eye checked by an eye doctor, especially if the rash is on the tip of the nose, the eye is red or your vision is reduced. Vaccination lowers the risk of shingles in people over 50.
حرق سطحي في القرنية من الأشعة فوق البنفس: A surface burn of the cornea from ultraviolet light after welding without a mask or exposure to sunlight reflected off snow or water. Symptoms appear 6 to 12 hours later, with severe pain and watering in both eyes.
يتحسن غالبًا خلال يوم إلى ثلاثة أيام مع: It usually improves within one to three days with rest in a dark room, cold compresses, artificial tears and an oral painkiller; a doctor may prescribe an antibiotic ointment. Do not use numbing eye drops at home as they slow healing. Seek care if it has not improved within two days or your vision gets worse.
ترقّق تدريجي في القرنية يجعلها تبرز على: Gradual thinning of the cornea that makes it bulge into a cone shape. It usually starts in the teenage years, causing increasing astigmatism and blurred vision, and is linked to eye rubbing and allergies.
يحتاج فحصًا لدى طبيب العيون مع تصوير طبو: It needs an eye doctor's examination with corneal topography (mapping). The most important treatment to stop it progressing is corneal strengthening with ultraviolet light and riboflavin (cross-linking). Vision is corrected with glasses or special rigid lenses, and a corneal transplant may be needed in advanced stages. Stop rubbing your eyes and treat any allergies.
عدوى متكررة في العين بجرثومة الكلاميديا: A repeated eye infection with the bacterium Chlamydia trachomatis, spread in areas with water shortages and overcrowding. Repeated infections scar the eyelid and turn the eyelashes inward, and it is one of the leading causes of preventable blindness.
يُعالج بمضاد حيوي يصفه الطبيب، مع علاج ا: It is treated with an antibiotic prescribed by a doctor, with treatment of household contacts through public health programs, daily face washing and better hygiene and sanitation (the WHO SAFE strategy). Eyelashes rubbing against the eye need eyelid surgery to prevent blindness.
التهاب في عين الرضيع خلال الأسابيع الأرب: Inflammation of a baby's eye in the first four weeks of life. It may be caused by germs passed on during birth, such as gonorrhea and chlamydia, and can damage the cornea quickly.
يحتاج فحصًا طبيًا في اليوم نفسه مع أخذ م: It needs a same-day medical examination with a swab of the discharge, because gonorrhea infection can damage the cornea within hours and needs intravenous treatment, while chlamydia needs oral treatment and can cause pneumonia. The mother and her partner also need to be tested and treated.

إفرازات من الأذن مستمرة أكثر من أسبوعين: Discharge from the ear lasting more than two weeks with little or no pain

التلف غالبًا دائم لذا الوقاية هي الأساس:: The damage is usually permanent, so prevention is key: use earplugs or ear defenders and turn down headphone volume. See a doctor for a hearing test, and urgently within a day if the hearing loss was sudden after an explosion, as early treatment may help.

إدخال جسم صغير في فتحة الأنف، غالبًا لدى: A small object is put into a nostril, usually by children. It may go unnoticed until foul-smelling discharge appears from one side.

Seek care soon if you develop fever, pus or redness, as the gland may be infected.

See a doctor if it does not improve within two weeks or keeps coming back, to check for anemia and diabetes and the fit of your denture.

لا تحتاج علاجًا لأنها غير معدية وغير خطي: No treatment is needed, as it is not contagious or serious. Avoid irritating foods if you have sensitivity, and a soothing mouthwash can be used. See a doctor if a patch stays in the same place for more than 3 weeks or comes with severe pain.

يحتاج تقييمًا لدى الطبيب أو طبيب الفم لا: It needs assessment by a doctor or oral medicine specialist to rule out treatable causes. Seek care soon if red spots, an ulcer or hardening appear in it.

يحتاج تقييمًا لدى جراح الفم أو طبيب الأن: It needs assessment by an oral surgeon or ENT specialist; treatment is usually surgery to remove the sublingual gland to stop it coming back. فقدان تدريجي لطبقة المينا بفعل الأحماض (: Gradual loss of tooth enamel caused by acids (fizzy drinks, juices, reflux and frequent vomiting) without bacteria being involved. It makes the tooth edges see-through and sensitive.
قلّل المشروبات الحمضية واشربها بالمصاصة: Cut down on acidic drinks and drink them through a straw with meals, rinse your mouth with water afterwards, wait an hour before brushing, and use a fluoride toothpaste. Treat reflux if present. See a dentist to assess the erosion and protect your teeth, and if frequent vomiting is the cause, discuss this with a doctor.

If it is dirty, rinse it briefly in milk or saline without scrubbing, and put it back in its socket straight away if possible, then bite on a piece of cloth. إصابة السن بضربة تسبب كسرًا في التاج أو: A blow to a tooth causes a fracture of the crown or root, loosening, or a change in its position. The nerve may be affected even if the fracture looks minor.
احتفظ بالجزء المكسور في الحليب أو الماء،: Keep the broken piece in milk or water and see a dentist within 24 hours; go the same day if the tooth's pulp is exposed (a red dot), the tooth has moved out of place, or you cannot close your mouth properly. تقليل ملامسة الماء والمنظفات، ولبس القفا: Reduce contact with water and detergents, wear gloves, and use a soap substitute and a thick moisturizer after every wash. See a doctor if it continues for more than two weeks despite this, your hands crack and bleed, or there are signs of infection.

ترطيب مكثف بانتظام وتجنّب الصابون المعطّ: Moisturize thoroughly and regularly, and avoid perfumed soaps and hot water. A steroid cream prescribed by a doctor is usually needed. See a doctor if the patches spread or develop yellow crusts or pus.

تقييم عاجل في اليوم نفسه، وكثيرًا ما يحت: Urgent same-day assessment is needed, and hospital admission is often required to replace fluids, keep the person warm, find the cause and stop any suspected medicine. حُمّى مفاجئة مع طفح أحمر منتشر يشبه حروق: Sudden fever with a widespread red rash like sunburn and dizziness or fainting
حُمّى مع آلام شديدة جدًا في مفاصل اليدين: Fever with very severe pain in the joints of the hands and feet after travel to a tropical area
تضخم غدة مؤلمة قرب موضع خدش أو عضة قطة ق: A painful swollen gland near the site of a cat scratch or bite from a few weeks ago
حُمّى خفيفة مع آلام عامة وإرهاق دون أعرا: Mild fever with general aches and tiredness, without symptoms in a specific organ
حُمّى مرتفعة مفاجئة مع مغص: Sudden high fever with abdominal cramps
إسهال أو زحار متقطع يتطور تدريجيًا على م: On-and-off diarrhea or dysentery developing gradually over a week or more

حالة طارئة: توجّه إلى الطوارئ فورًا أو ا: This is an emergency: go to the emergency department straight away or call an ambulance. It needs intravenous antibiotics and fluids within the first hour and monitoring in hospital. Those most at risk are older people, babies, people with diabetes and people with a weakened immune system.
عدوى فيروسية بفيروس إبشتاين-بار تصيب الم: A viral infection with the Epstein-Barr virus that mostly affects teenagers and young adults, causing fever, a severe sore throat, swollen lymph nodes and tiredness that may last weeks, and sometimes an enlarged spleen.
راحة وسوائل ومسكنات للحرارة والألم، ويُؤ: Rest, fluids and medicines for fever and pain; the diagnosis is confirmed with a blood test. Avoid contact sports for 4 to 6 weeks because of the risk of the spleen rupturing. Go to the emergency department if you have sudden severe pain in the left side of the abdomen or difficulty swallowing or breathing.
عدوى فيروسية خفيفة غالبًا تسبب طفحًا ورد: A usually mild viral infection that causes a pink rash starting on the face and swollen glands behind the ears. Its biggest danger is to the unborn baby if a pregnant woman catches it in early pregnancy. It is prevented by the MMR vaccine.
راحة وسوائل وخافض حرارة، والابتعاد عن ال: Rest, fluids and a fever reducer, and stay away from pregnant women and school or work until 7 days after the rash appears. A pregnant woman who has been in contact with someone with rubella or develops a rash should see a doctor straight away.
مرض خطير يسببه سم بكتيريا تعيش في التربة: A serious disease caused by a toxin from bacteria that live in soil and manure and enter through wounds. It causes jaw stiffness and painful muscle spasms that can affect the breathing muscles. It is prevented by vaccination.
حالة طارئة: توجّه إلى الطوارئ فورًا. يُع: This is an emergency: go to the emergency department straight away. It is treated in hospital, usually in intensive care, with immunoglobulin, an antibiotic, muscle-relaxing medicines and wound cleaning. A booster dose every 10 years prevents it.
جرح عميق أو ملوث بالتراب أو الروث، أو وخ: A deep wound or one contaminated with soil or manure, a puncture from a nail, a burn or a bite, in a person who has not completed tetanus vaccination, whose last booster was many years ago, or who does not know their vaccination status.
تنظيف الجرح جيدًا بالماء والصابون، ثم ال: Clean the wound well with soap and water, then go to a health center or emergency department within a few hours to assess whether you need a tetanus booster or immunoglobulin, depending on the type of wound and your vaccination status.
عدوى طفيلية تنقلها لدغة ذبابة الرمل، تظه: A parasitic infection spread by sand fly bites. It appears as a painless bump on exposed skin that slowly turns into a sore with a raised edge over a few weeks, and is found in North Africa and the Middle East.
فحص لدى طبيب الجلدية أو الأمراض المعدية: See a dermatologist or infectious disease specialist and have a sample taken to confirm the diagnosis. Many sores heal on their own within months, leaving a scar; they may be treated with local injections, freezing or whole-body treatment depending on their number and location. Prevent it with bed nets and insect repellent.
عدوى طفيلية خطيرة تنقلها ذبابة الرمل، تص: A serious parasitic infection spread by sand flies that affects the spleen, liver and bone marrow, causing on-and-off fever for weeks, weight loss, an enlarged spleen and anemia. It can be fatal without treatment.
تحتاج إلى تقييم سريع لدى طبيب الأمراض ال: It needs prompt assessment by an infectious disease specialist or a fever hospital to confirm the diagnosis with tests and start antiparasitic treatment under monitoring.
عدوى طفيلية تنتقل من فضلات القطط أو اللح: A parasitic infection spread from cat feces, undercooked meat or unwashed vegetables. It usually causes no symptoms or only swollen glands and mild tiredness, but it is dangerous for unborn babies and people with a weakened immune system.
لا تحتاج غالبًا إلى علاج لدى الأصحاء. يج: It usually needs no treatment in healthy people. Pregnant women and people with a weakened immune system should see a doctor for an antibody test and to discuss treatment. Prevent it by cooking meat thoroughly, washing vegetables and wearing gloves when cleaning cat litter.
عدوى بكتيرية تنقلها لدغة القراد في الغاب: A bacterial infection spread by tick bites in forests and grassy areas in Europe and North America. It usually starts with a red patch that spreads like a target around the bite, and may later affect the joints, nerves and heart.
يصف الطبيب مضادًا حيويًا فمويًا عند ظهور: A doctor will prescribe an oral antibiotic when the typical rash appears; no test is needed at this stage. Remove the tick with tweezers close to the skin. See a doctor soon if you develop facial weakness, palpitations or joint pain after the bite.
عدوى بكتيرية تنتقل من بول الفئران والحيو: A bacterial infection spread from the urine of rats and other animals through contaminated water and soil. It causes sudden fever, headache, severe calf muscle pain and red eyes, and can affect the liver, kidneys and lungs.
تحتاج إلى تقييم طبي في اليوم نفسه ومضاد: It needs same-day medical assessment and early antibiotics. Go to the emergency department if you develop yellow eyes, pass little urine, have bleeding or are short of breath. Prevent it by wearing boots and gloves when wading through contaminated water.
أعراض تستمر أو تظهر بعد 12 أسبوعًا من عد: Symptoms that continue or appear 12 weeks after a COVID-19 infection and are not explained by another cause. The most common are tiredness, shortness of breath, poor concentration, sleep problems and palpitations.
تقييم لدى الطبيب لاستبعاد أسباب أخرى بال: See a doctor to rule out other causes with tests and a chest X-ray depending on symptoms, then follow a gradual rehabilitation program and pace your activity without overexertion. Go to the emergency department if you have chest pain or severe shortness of breath.
الاشتباه في متلازمة الشرق الأوسط التنفسي: Suspected Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS, camel coronavirus)
عدوى تنفسية بفيروس كورونا تنتقل من الإبل: A respiratory infection with a coronavirus spread from camels and between people in hospitals. It causes fever, cough and shortness of breath, may progress to severe pneumonia, and is reported in the Arabian Peninsula.
اتصل بالمستشفى أو الطوارئ قبل الذهاب لإب: Call the hospital or emergency department before going to let them know about the suspected infection, wear a mask and keep away from others. It needs isolation, a swab test and supportive treatment. Go to the emergency department straight away if you are severely short of breath.
إسهال يصيب المسافرين خلال الرحلة أو بعده: Diarrhea affecting travelers during or shortly after a trip due to contaminated food or water. The most common cause is E. coli bacteria, and it usually clears within 3 to 5 days.
شرب السوائل ومحلول معالجة الجفاف الفموي: Drink fluids and oral rehydration solution and eat light meals. See a doctor if there is blood in the stool, a high fever, diarrhea lasting more than 3 days or signs of dehydration. Prevent it by drinking bottled water and avoiding raw foods.
حمّى تتجاوز 38.3 درجة وتتكرر لأكثر من 3: A fever above 38.3°C that keeps coming back for more than 3 weeks without a clear cause after initial tests. Causes include hidden infections such as tuberculosis, brucellosis and endocarditis, rheumatic diseases or tumors.
تحتاج إلى تقييم منظم لدى طبيب الباطنة أو: It needs a structured assessment by an internal medicine or infectious disease specialist: a detailed medical history, blood tests, blood cultures and imaging. Record your temperature daily. See a doctor soon if you have weight loss, night sweats or new symptoms.
تسمم نادر وخطير بسم بكتيريا المطثية الوش: A rare, serious poisoning by the toxin of Clostridium botulinum bacteria in improperly canned or home-preserved foods or salted fish (such as fesikh). It causes paralysis that starts with the eyes and swallowing, then moves down to the limbs and breathing muscles.
حالة طارئة: توجّه إلى الطوارئ فورًا. يحت: This is an emergency: go to the emergency department straight away. It needs antitoxin, monitoring in intensive care and possibly a breathing machine. Keep any leftover suspected food and report anyone who ate it with you.
عدوى معوية بطفيل الأنتاميبا هستوليتيكا ع: An intestinal infection with the parasite Entamoeba histolytica through contaminated water or food. It causes diarrhea with mucus and blood that develops gradually, with cramps, and can cause a liver abscess.
تأكيد التشخيص بتحليل البراز أو المستضد،: The diagnosis is confirmed with a stool or antigen test, followed by antiparasitic treatment prescribed by a doctor and then a medicine to clear cysts from the bowel. Note that the test can give false results by confusing it with harmless species. See a doctor soon if you have pain in the upper right abdomen with fever.
عدوى معوية بكتيرية شديدة العدوى تنتقل با: A highly contagious bacterial intestinal infection spread by hands and contaminated food. It starts suddenly with fever and cramps, followed by diarrhea with mucus and blood and tenesmus, and spreads among children and in crowded settings.
سوائل ومحلول معالجة الجفاف، ويصف الطبيب: Fluids and oral rehydration solution; a doctor may prescribe a suitable antibiotic depending on the case. Avoid anti-diarrhea medicines. Wash hands well to prevent spread. Go to the emergency department if there are signs of dehydration, seizures in a child or reduced urine.
عدوى معوية بطفيل الجيارديا عبر الماء أو: An intestinal infection with the Giardia parasite through contaminated water or food. It causes greasy, foul-smelling diarrhea with bloating, gas and loss of appetite, may last for weeks, and can cause weight loss in children.
تأكيد التشخيص بتحليل البراز ثم دواء مضاد: The diagnosis is confirmed with a stool test, followed by an antiparasitic medicine prescribed by a doctor. Drink fluids, eat light meals, wash hands and drink clean water. Lactose intolerance may continue for weeks after treatment.
عدوى بديدان الكبد المفلطحة تنتقل بأكل ال: An infection with flat liver worms spread by eating watercress and raw leafy vegetables irrigated with water contaminated by livestock feces. It causes fever, pain in the upper right abdomen and raised eosinophils in the blood, and is endemic in Egypt.
فحص لدى الطبيب بتحليل الدم والأجسام المض: See a doctor for blood and antibody tests and imaging; treatment is with an effective anti-worm medicine prescribed by a doctor. Prevent it by washing leafy vegetables thoroughly and avoiding those grown with canal water.
عدوى بيرقات دودة شريطية من فضلات الكلاب: An infection with tapeworm larvae from dog feces that form slow-growing fluid-filled cysts, usually in the liver and then the lungs. They may cause no symptoms for years, then cause heaviness or pain in the upper abdomen or a cough.
تقييم لدى الطبيب بالأشعة والتحاليل، والع: See a doctor for imaging and tests; treatment depends on the size and stage of the cyst: monitoring, an anti-worm medicine, drainage through the skin, or surgery. Go to the emergency department if you have sudden severe pain or an itchy rash with dizziness (possible cyst rupture).
عدوى بديدان أسطوانية كبيرة تنتقل بأكل خض: An infection with large roundworms spread by eating vegetables or food contaminated with soil. It is most common in children, usually causes no symptoms or only cramps and poor nutrition, and the worm may be passed in the stool.
يصف الطبيب دواءً مضادًا للديدان، وقد يُع: A doctor will prescribe an anti-worm medicine, and family members may also be treated. Wash hands before eating and wash vegetables well. Go to the emergency department if there is repeated vomiting with a swollen belly and no bowel movements.
عدوى بكتيرية خطيرة تُوقى منها باللقاح، ت: A serious bacterial infection preventable by vaccination. It causes a sore throat with a gray membrane stuck to the throat that can block the airway, and swelling of the neck; its toxin can affect the heart and nerves.
حالة طارئة: توجّه إلى الطوارئ فورًا. يحت: This is an emergency: go to the emergency department straight away. It needs antitoxin, an antibiotic and isolation in hospital, and close contacts are given preventive treatment. Full vaccination is the prevention.
عدوى بكتيرية تنقلها لدغات القراد أو البر: A bacterial infection spread by tick, flea or louse bites, causing fever, severe headache, muscle aches and a rash; a black scab may appear at the bite site. It is found in the Mediterranean region, including murine typhus in Egypt.
تحتاج إلى تقييم في اليوم نفسه وبدء مضاد: It needs same-day assessment and early antibiotics based on the clinical assessment, without waiting for test results. Go to the emergency department if you develop confusion, shortness of breath or bleeding.
عدوى بكتيرية نادرة تنتقل من الماشية النا: A rare bacterial infection spread from dead livestock or their hides or wool. It starts as an itchy bump that turns into a painless sore with a black scab in the center and swelling around it.
تحتاج إلى تقييم طبي في اليوم نفسه ومضاد: It needs same-day medical assessment and antibiotics, and the health authorities should be notified. Do not try to open the sore. Go to the emergency department if you have a high fever, neck swelling or shortness of breath.
عدوى فيروسية تنتقل بالمخالطة الجسدية الق: A viral infection spread through close physical contact. It causes fever and swollen lymph nodes, followed by a rash that turns into deep pustules of similar size on the face, limbs or genitals.
اتصل بالطبيب أو الجهة الصحية لإجراء المس: Contact a doctor or the health authority for a swab test, and stay isolated with the rash covered until the scabs fall off and the skin heals. Treatment is mostly supportive. Go to the emergency department if the eye is affected, or you have severe pain, difficulty swallowing or passing urine, or a weakened immune system.
أشيع أشكال السل خارج الرئة، يظهر بتضخم غ: The most common form of tuberculosis outside the lungs. It appears as a painless swollen gland in the neck that grows slowly over weeks and may soften and drain, sometimes with mild fever or night sweats.
فحص لدى الطبيب بالأشعة التلفزيونية وأخذ: See a doctor for an ultrasound scan and a needle sample or biopsy to confirm the diagnosis, followed by a full course of tuberculosis treatment for several months through the national tuberculosis program.
عدوى بكتيرية نادرة وسريعة جدًا تدمر الأن: A rare and very rapid bacterial infection that destroys the tissues under the skin. It starts with severe pain out of proportion to how the skin looks, followed by rapid swelling, dark blisters and fever. It is more common in people with diabetes or a weakened immune system.
حالة طارئة: توجّه إلى الطوارئ فورًا. تحت: This is an emergency: go to the emergency department straight away. It needs urgent surgery to remove dead tissue and intravenous antibiotics in hospital; even a few hours' delay greatly increases the risk.
حالة نادرة وخطيرة تسببها سموم بكتيريا عن: A rare, serious condition caused by toxins from staphylococcus or streptococcus bacteria, linked to tampons, wounds or burns. It causes sudden fever, a widespread sunburn-like rash and low blood pressure.
حالة طارئة: أزيلي السدادة القطنية إن وجد: This is an emergency: remove the tampon if there is one and go to the emergency department straight away. It needs fluids, intravenous antibiotics and monitoring in intensive care.
عدوى فيروسية ينقلها بعوض الزاعجة في المن: A viral infection spread by Aedes mosquitoes in tropical areas, causing sudden fever and very severe pain in the joints of the hands and feet that may last weeks or months, sometimes with a rash.
راحة وسوائل وخافض حرارة (الباراسيتامول)،: Rest, fluids and a fever reducer (paracetamol), and avoid anti-inflammatories until dengue has been ruled out. See a doctor for testing, and go to the emergency department if there is bleeding, severe abdominal pain or persistent vomiting.
عدوى بكتيرية (البارتونيلا) تنتقل بخدش أو: A bacterial infection (Bartonella) usually spread by a scratch or bite from a young cat. It causes a bump at the scratch site, followed weeks later by a painful swollen gland nearby, with mild fever and tiredness.
يزول غالبًا وحده خلال أسابيع إلى أشهر، و: It usually clears on its own within weeks to months; a doctor may prescribe an antibiotic for very swollen glands or for people with a weakened immune system. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes of swollen glands.
عدوى فيروسية عابرة تسبب حمّى خفيفة إلى م: A passing viral infection causing mild to moderate fever, general aches and tiredness without clear symptoms in a specific organ. It improves within 3 to 5 days.
راحة وسوائل وخافض حرارة عند الحاجة، ولا: Rest, fluids and a fever reducer if needed; antibiotics do not help. See a doctor if the fever lasts more than 3 days, or if a rash, severe headache with a stiff neck, shortness of breath or confusion appears, or after travel to a malaria area.
